description: Find companies similar to one to ten seed company domains (your best customers or a competitor). Returns lookalike companies ranked by a 0 to 100 similarity score with the evidence: score_breakdown_json (shared homepage words, search mentions, named in a comparison, shared tools, business model match, Reddit co-mention, shared marketplaces), found_via, shared_keywords, tech_detected, has_pricing_page, and homepage title, plus one free seed summary row. Candidates come from alternatives, vs, and competitors search result pages and the products list articles name; review sites, list articles, and media are never returned. use_classifier (default true), use_reddit, and use_marketplaces start Mamba Labs actors as child runs that Apify bills to your account at their own prices. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per lookalike company returned.

classify_top_n.description: Top candidates the business model check reads, 1 to 50. Default 15.

exclude_domains.description: Domains never to return, for example your own and your current customers.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount. Child runs are billed by their own actors.

max_results.description: Lookalike companies returned, best first, 1 to 100. Each one is billed. Default 25.

min_score.description: Only companies scoring at least this, 0 to 100. Default 20.

seed_domain.description: One seed domain. Used together with seed_domains.

seed_domains.description: One to ten seed company domains, for example smartlead.ai.

use_classifier.description: Run Mamba Labs Website Phrase and Business Model Classifier on the seeds and top candidates (child run billed at its own price). Default true.

use_marketplaces.description: Run Mamba Labs Integration and Marketplace Presence Mapper on the seeds and top candidates (child run billed at its own price). Default false.

use_reddit.description: Run Mamba Labs B2B Reddit Conversation Monitor on each seed for co-mentions (child run billed at its own prices). Default false.

name: find_lookalike_companies
title: Find lookalike companies
